image_description: A close-up studio shot of a multi-strand beaded necklace displayed on a white cylindrical jewelry bust. The necklace features a complex woven pattern of small, translucent greenish-grey tubular beads and tiny spherical metallic spacer beads, creating a fringe-like or chevron texture. The background is a plain, soft-focus white.
